full_judgment: 2. The short fact leading to this appeal is that complainant Syed Zahid Hossain, Advocate field Complaint Case No.301 of 1995 under section 466/468 and 471 of the Penal Code against the accused-appellants before the Magistrate, First Class, Bagerhat alleging that the appellant filed various objection cases for mutation of certain lands mentioned in the petition of complaint before the Settlement Officer, Rampal against the complainant and others alleging that the accused persons used a forged decree of Title Suit No.177 of 1946 of the Court of Subordinate Judge, Khulna. Their case is that the aforesaid suit was not decreed on 25.3.1964 but was dismissed on 23.5.1950 and as such decree dated 25.3.1964 is an act of forgery. The Magistrate examined the complainant under section 200 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and asked for a report in respect of the alleged forged decree from the Settlement Officer, Rampal which report was submitted on 13.12.1995 and on receipt of that the Magistrate took Cognizance under sections 466/468/471 of the Penal Code and issued warrant of arrest against the appellants. Thereafter the appellants surrendered before the Magistrate and were enlarged on bail. The appellants then moved the High Court Division in Criminal Revision No.724of 1997 under section 561 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the proceeding but the rule was discharged on 12.8.1998
